name: Tsukiji Tobimaru
source: The popular vice-president of the Student Council, a classmate of Aoko who becomes Soujuurou's best friend. He and Aoko were close friends as children, though they both deny having any feelings for one another. His family life is apparently complicated and he is known to casually smoke and spend nights out. Kojika Kumari has a crush on him which he is oblivious of.
